<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="exX062023-02-2315-43-12" type="excerpt" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4576">bdag nyid chen po dbu ma pa shes rab 'bum</rs> gyis sbyar ba las | de nyid brjod bya'i don zab cing rgya che ba rnams ji lta ba <abbr>bzhin</abbr> du ston pas de las khyad par du byar med kyang | rjod byed kyi tshig brling zhing 'ga' zhig ngag don du mdzad de gzhung la ma sbyar ba dang | phal cher rgya 'grel ltar sbyar ba mang bas las dang po ba rnams kyis blos <lb n="153a2"/> bslang dka' bar gyur pa dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4576">bdag nyid chen po</rs> de nyid kyang 'di la snon 'brid cung zad 'dra dang zhu dag cig dgos par 'dug ste zhes yang yang gsung ba rjes su dran pa dang | gzhan yang sde snod 'dzin pa mang <choice><orig>zhi‹g›</orig><reg>zhig</reg></choice> gis bskul ba'i ngor | 'jug pa bde zhing brjod bya'i don rnams ma tshang ba med par ston la | brjod kyi tshig zin pa tsam gyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i sde snod 'dzin <lb n="153a3"/> pa ltar 'gyur ba 'di ni | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4576">bdag nyid chen po dbu ma pa yab sras</rs> kyi bka' drin la brten nas | lung rigs man ngag gi gnad rnams phyin ci ma log par khong du chud cing | 'chad pa dang | rtsod pa dang | rtsom pa'i tshul la blo gros kyi snang ba yongs su rgyas pa'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5518">bo dong ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs sho re pa</rs>s | <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4369"> dpal ldan brag ram gyi gtsug lag khang chen po</rs>r <note type="editorial">This is assumed to be the same as brag ram mgon khang (id: 4369) </note> <lb n="153a4"/> nye bar sbyar ba 'di | re shig rdzogs s+ho ||</seg></TEI>
